-- $* Factory benchmark generated from semantic source summary only for mac_17
-- $* Source path: docs/codebase/macros/JDE_class-mapping-rename.pmlmac
-- $* Run path: $m "C:\Users\ADZV\OneDrive - Ramboll\AVEVA_SERVER\Addons\PMLLIB\RAM\Engineering\jackdow\JDE_class-mapping-rename.pmlmac"
-- $* PML rename group class - attribute mapping
-- $* Author: Andrei Aitzhanov
-- $* Company Ramboll Energies
-- $* Date: 23-01-2025


handle any
endhandle


-- Collect all ShellClassAttributeMapping objects with filter:
-- valid class group ref, valid attribute mapping ref, and not yet named
var !classAttributeList collect all :ShellClassAttributeMapping with (not(badref(:MappingRefToClassGroup)) and not(badref(:MappingRefToAttributeMapping)) and not(ISNAMED))

-- Iterate over each collected item by value
do !classAttributeItem values !classAttributeList
	-- Obtain a database reference from the collected item
	!classAttributeItemRef = !classAttributeItem.dbref()
	-- Dynamic property access via colon syntax to read linked class group name
	!classGroupName = !classAttributeItemRef.:MappingRefToClassGroup.namn
	-- Dynamic property access via colon syntax to read linked attribute name
	!attributeName = !classAttributeItemRef.:MappingRefToAttributeMapping.namn
	-- String interpolation: build composite name from class group and attribute
	!name = |/$!<classGroupName>/$!<attributeName>|
	-- Get the length of the constructed name
	!len = !name.length()
	-- Issue PML NAME command to rename the element (pre-truncation)
	$P $!classAttributeItem NAME $!name
	-- Truncate to 50 characters if name is too long
	if (!len GT 50) then
		!name = !name.Substring(1,50)
	endif
	
	-- Assign the (possibly truncated) name back to the object via dbref
	!classAttributeItemRef.name = !name
enddo
